from z3 import *

# Create 6x6 grid of integer variables
n = 6
cells = [[Int(f'c_{i}_{j}') for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]

solver = Solver()

# Each cell is between 1 and 36
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        solver.add(cells[i][j] >= 1, cells[i][j] <= 36)

# All values are distinct
flat = [cells[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n)]
solver.add(Distinct(*flat))

magic_sum = 111

# Row sums
for i in range(n):
    solver.add(Sum([cells[i][j] for j in range(n)]) == magic_sum)

# Column sums
for j in range(n):
    solver.add(Sum([cells[i][j] for i in range(n)]) == magic_sum)

# Main diagonal
solver.add(Sum([cells[i][i] for i in range(n)]) == magic_sum)

# Anti-diagonal
solver.add(Sum([cells[i][n-1-i] for i in range(n)]) == magic_sum)

result = solver.check()
print(result)

if result == sat:
    model = solver.model()
    solution = []
    for i in range(n):
        row = []
        for j in range(n):
            val = model[cells[i][j]].as_long()
            row.append(val)
        solution.append(row)
    
    # Print the magic square
    for row in solution:
        print(row)
    
    # Verify
    flat_sol = [solution[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n)]
    print("\nFlat solution:", flat_sol)
    print("All values 1-36:", sorted(flat_sol) == list(range(1, 37)))
    
    # Check sums

    print(f"Diag: {sum(solution[i][i] for i in range(n))}")
    print(f"Anti-diag: {sum(solution[i][n-1-i] for i in range(n))}")
